findings.text: candidate_program() locates the truncation point with next() over an AST walk for a bare 'saddle_index = ...' assignment; if _read_at_nulls is refactored so that statement is moved or renamed the helper raises StopIteration rather than a message naming what broke, so a product-side refactor surfaces as an opaque test error in a test whose subject is candidate admission.

test_candidate_slots_share_one_program rejects only a jaxpr scan whose params['length'] equals policy.null_capacity, so an unrolled Python loop over the sixteen slots restores exactly the sequential evaluation this node removed and still passes; the structural guard is narrower than the batching claim it is cited for.

the sentence 'The structural regression reproduces at base' points at reproduction-test_candidate_inspection_batched.log, whose header names base b471be60 but whose tree field names the head worktree, and whose failing source line reads 'assert not scans' where the committed test reads 'assert len(scans) == 0'; the witness does not correspond line-for-line to the test it is offered as a red receipt for.
